entries.title: YES Programme Placement
entries.subtitle: 12 months paid work experience · no experience needed
entries.description: The Youth Employment Service places unemployed 18-34 year olds with private employers for 12 months at a stipend of about R5,241 per month. No prior work experience is required; matric is usually requested by the host employer. Apply through SA Youth (zero-rated) and you can only do YES once.

entries.title: Graduate Internship: Marketing
entries.subtitle: 12-month internship · degree required, experience not
entries.description: FMCG brand team internship covering campaign support, social media and retailer activations. Structured mentorship and a certificate on completion. Open to graduates who completed their qualification in the last 3 years.

entries.title: Learnership: Software Testing NQF5
entries.subtitle: 18 months · stipend · matric or diploma
entries.description: Accredited software testing learnership combining classroom modules with placement on live QA teams. Covers manual testing, test automation basics and defect reporting. Stipend paid monthly, and the NQF5 certificate is recognised by employers.

entries.title: Junior Data Capturer
entries.subtitle: Entry level · no experience required
entries.description: Capture and validate records for a municipal pilot. Full training provided on the first two days. Suited to a first-time job seeker who is accurate and comfortable with spreadsheets.

entries.title: Graduate Programme: Bank Operations
entries.subtitle: 18-month rotational programme
entries.description: Rotations across branch operations, credit and customer care, with a permanent-role review at the end. Requires a completed degree in commerce, finance or business; no work experience required.

entries.title: Work-Shadow a CA(SA)
entries.subtitle: 1 week · unpaid · certificate
entries.description: Spend a week shadowing a chartered accountant during month-end close. You will see reconciliations, audit preparation and client meetings. Treated as verifiable experience you can put on your CV.

entries.title: Entry-Level Job Board
entries.subtitle: Filter to roles that ask for 0 years
entries.description: Every listing on this board is screened so that it explicitly requires no previous work experience. Updated daily, with the original advert linked for verification.

entries.title: CV Builder for Graduates
entries.subtitle: Turns coursework into experience bullets
entries.description: Guided builder that converts modules, projects, tutoring, volunteering and campus roles into CV-ready achievement bullets. Exports a clean PDF and flags gaps recruiters ask about. Uses your real inputs only, never invented experience.

entries.title: Interview Simulator
entries.subtitle: Role-specific questions with feedback
entries.description: Practice the questions that actually come up for your target role. Answers are scored on structure, evidence and clarity, and you get a rewritten example answer. Handles competency, technical and salary questions.

entries.title: Application Tracker
entries.subtitle: Saved → Applied → Interview → Offer
entries.description: Track every application in one place with deadline reminders and follow-up prompts. Shows your conversion rate by channel so you stop applying where nothing works.

entries.title: NYDA Grant Programme
entries.subtitle: R1,000 – R200,000 non-repayable · ages 18-35
entries.description: Youth-owned businesses can apply for a non-repayable grant across four tiers: survivalist R1,000-R10,000, start-up R10,001-R50,000, growth R50,001-R100,000, expansion R100,001-R200,000 (co-operatives up to R250,000, agriculture and technology up to R300,000). Requirements: South African citizen aged 18-35, 100% youth-owned, turnover under R750,000, and completion of the free Business Management Training, which is a prerequisite.

entries.title: SEFA Small Business Loan
entries.subtitle: Loans from R500 to R15 million
entries.description: Small Enterprise Finance Agency funding for businesses that cannot access commercial credit. Includes township and rural entrepreneurship streams and some blended grant-and-loan products. Requires a business plan and registration.

entries.title: Youth Business Bank Account
entries.subtitle: Zero-fee account + starter tools
entries.description: Business account designed for under-35 founders: no monthly fee for 12 months, invoicing template, payment links and a debit order facility. Bundled with bookkeeping basics.

entries.title: Co-Founder Matching
entries.subtitle: Find someone who covers your gaps
entries.description: Skills-based matching for graduates who want to build together. Profiles show what you can do (build, sell, design, operate), what you have (time, capital, network) and what you need. Introductions are mutual and time-boxed to a two-week trial.

entries.title: Mentor Marketplace
entries.subtitle: Book 30 minutes with an operator
entries.description: Verified founders, accountants and operators pledge hours each month. Book a 30-minute call by sector: retail, tech, agriculture, services, creative. Every session ends with three concrete next actions.

entries.title: Idea Validation Sprint
entries.subtitle: 48 hours from idea to go/no-go
entries.description: Guided sprint: define the problem, write the riskiest assumption, run 10 customer conversations, then decide go, pivot or stop. Includes scripts, a scoring sheet and a reviewer who reads your result.

entries.title: Funding Readiness Checklist
entries.subtitle: Know exactly which document is missing
entries.description: Step-by-step checklist covering CIPC registration, B-BBEE affidavit, tax clearance, bank confirmation, business plan and the NYDA training certificate. Each step links to the official page and shows how long it takes.

entries.title: CIPC Registration Walkthrough
entries.subtitle: Register your company in a day
entries.description: Screen-by-screen walkthrough of registering a private company, including name reservation, shareholding and the founder's tax number. Costs and timelines updated for 2026.

entries.title: Pitch Deck Review Clinic
entries.subtitle: Get your deck torn apart before a funder does
entries.description: Submit a 10-slide deck and get written feedback from an investor or an incubator coach within 72 hours. Focus areas: problem clarity, traction evidence, unit economics and the ask.

entries.title: Pre-Seed Incubator
entries.subtitle: 12 weeks · R50,000 stipend pool
entries.description: Cohort-based incubator for graduate founders with an idea or an early prototype. Weekly sessions on customer discovery, pricing and fundraising, ending in a demo day with funders in the room.

entries.title: Freelance Starter Kit
entries.subtitle: Land your first paying client
entries.description: Everything needed to sell a skill part-time: a one-page service page, pricing calculator, proposal template, invoice template and the first three outreach scripts. Includes a simple tax checklist for side income.

entries.title: Stokvel to Startup
entries.subtitle: Pool capital with people you trust
entries.description: A structured way to turn a stokvel into seed capital: written constitution template, contribution tracking, and a decision process for which member's business gets funded first.

entries.title: Career Path Maps
entries.subtitle: What can I actually do with my qualification?
entries.description: Pick your qualification and see the six most common realistic next moves, the entry requirement for each, typical starting pay and what to add to your CV to be competitive. Built from advertised roles, not opinion.

entries.title: Graduate Meetups
entries.subtitle: People in the same position, near you
entries.description: Monthly meetups in Bloemfontein, Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban and Pretoria for unemployed graduates and early founders. Peer-led, no entry fee, structured so nobody stands alone in a corner.

entries.title: Accountability Pods
entries.subtitle: Five graduates, one weekly check-in
entries.description: Small groups that meet weekly to report progress: applications sent, documents completed, customers spoken to. Pods are matched by goal and time zone, and a facilitator keeps the rhythm.

entries.title: Excel and Power BI Bootcamp
entries.subtitle: Six weeks · evenings · certificate
entries.description: The spreadsheet and dashboard skills that appear in most entry-level admin, finance and operations adverts. Live evening classes, recorded, with weekly assignments marked by a tutor.

entries.title: Salary Guide by Qualification
entries.subtitle: Know what to ask for
entries.description: Starting and three-year salary bands by qualification and sector, sourced from advertised roles and verified by employer partners. Includes negotiation scripts for a first offer.

entries.title: Bursary Repayment Guidance
entries.subtitle: What you owe, and what relief exists
entries.description: Explains how NSFAS and bursary repayment obligations work, what deferral options exist while unemployed, and how to request a statement. Includes a calculator for monthly repayment once employed.

entries.title: Women in Business Fund
entries.subtitle: Targeted capital and mentorship
entries.description: Funding and mentorship stream for women founders under 35, combining a grant, six months of mentoring and a peer circle. Prioritises businesses in services, agriculture and creative industries.

entries.title: First 90 Days Playbook
entries.subtitle: Turn a 12-month placement into a job
entries.description: Week-by-week plan for the first three months of an internship, learnership or YES placement: what to learn, who to ask, which artefacts to save for your portfolio, and when to raise your hand for more.
